decks.name: LeetCode #703 - Kth Largest Element in a Stream
decks.description: Design class to find kth largest element in a stream

cards.question: Kth Largest Element in a Stream: Design a class to find the kth largest element in a stream. Note that it is the kth largest element in the sorted order, not the kth distinct element. Implement KthLargest class: KthLargest(int k, int[] nums) initializes the object with the integer k and the stream of integers nums. int add(int val) appends the integer val to the stream and returns the element representing the kth largest element in the stream.

solutions.name: Sorting
solutions.explanation: Maintain array storing all elements seen so far. For each add operation, append new value to array, sort entire array, and return kth largest element (array[length - k]). Simple but inefficient as we sort entire array on every add. Time complexity O(m*n log n) where m is number of add calls and n is current array size. Space O(m) for storing all elements.

solutions.name: Min-Heap
solutions.explanation: Maintain min-heap of size k containing k largest elements. Heap root is always kth largest. Initialize by heapifying input array and removing smallest elements until size k. For add operation, push new value to heap, if size exceeds k pop minimum. Return heap root. Efficient because heap operations are O(log k) and we only maintain k elements. Time O(m*log k) for m operations, space O(k).
